entries.summary: Read docs/OPENRIG.md, custom/skills/openrig-team/SKILL.md and config/openrig-roles.json for one central lead with 13 on-demand specialists. The default openrig component fetches original OpenRig 0.6.13, checks npm integrity and installs ai-team with private project state and shared global guidance. macOS/Linux run locally; native Windows installs only the SSH entrypoint to an authorised macOS/Linux host, without WSL. Start only relevant agents and preserve application approval boundaries. Installation starts no daemon, assigns no work and publishes no transcripts. Mac ARM64 install/rerun, Codex lead-to-QA coordination, backend activation and snapshot restoration passed. Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 12 ARM64 fresh/repeat installation, SQLite and daemon health/stop passed; Linux inference, x64 and actual Windows/SSH execution were not tested. Claude seat launched but inference failed with invalid OAuth; auth-status loggedIn was insufficient. Fixes: local host pinning, atomic startup guidance, state reconciliation after uncertain expand timeout, additive ignore rules, and missing build-essential/procps prerequisites on minimal Debian. Full suite 171 tests with four skips; final focused suite 11 passed. Existing unrelated whole-home rules/docs drift is preserved. This is availability and bounded coordination evidence, not a productivity benchmark or automatic cross-machine rollout.

For new frontends or substantial UI redesigns, inspect the product, choose relevant references, record adopt/adapt/reject decisions, establish or preserve design tokens and shared controls, prove one representative screen before expansion, add purposeful reduced-motion-aware animation and verify the rendered user journey. Landing pages, business dashboards and video editors need different layouts, density and motion. The catalog links Scrolltide, Navbar Gallery, Footer Design, CTA Gallery, Supahero, 3dicons, Refero, UI UX Pro Max, 21st.dev and Motion to their original providers. Paid research and additional provider installs are optional; no copied provider payloads, automatic app changes or measured quality gains are implied. The existing custom/rules/docs components distribute the guidance to Claude/Codex on macOS, Ubuntu/Debian and native Windows. App-specific design contracts and browser evidence stay with the app. Git is canonical; memory is a reviewed discovery pointer, not installation or guaranteed recall. entries.summary: Servinoza decisions reviewed 7 October 2026: approved native target is React Native CLI with native screens, no Expo and no WebView application UI, not a Kotlin/Swift rewrite. CX and PX remain separate installed apps in the mobile owner repo; shared gateway routing never replaces server authorization or permits cross-role login. Wrong-role login must not disclose another account role. Three design owners are servinoza-design-brand (artwork/guidance), servinoza-design-web (web presentation) and servinoza-design-native (native presentation). Web/native semantic tokens may differ permanently; brand adoption is explicit, not automatic synchronization. Sessions, APIs, navigation, device lifecycle and business rules stay outside design libraries. Preserve immutable releases, exact consumer pins and npm identities on repo renames; compatibility packages persist until explicit upgrades. Production policy is merge approved work to main, pin clean SHA, build and promote immutable artifacts, then verify public behavior. VM-based build/push/deploy is the owner-selected delivery direction; browser suites were removed from the deployment critical path, not from product acceptance. Record approval-to-deployed separately from stage timing. Department and environment scores require independent evidence; screenshot presence alone cannot prove backend, financial, security or latency claims. Installed-device acceptance is separate from mobile web. PASS is bounded to tested assertions; BLOCKED includes unfinished work with exact reason, execution state, owner and retest condition. Keep current public reports per flow and local scratch ignored. One-time scripts stay project-local and ignored; maintained tools/migrations stay versioned. This is a decision/source review, not proof of completed native migration, consumer adoption, universal main-branch guards or new live tests. Detailed private decisions stay in servinoza-docs/DECISIONS.md and its owner links. This later review supersedes inconsistent earlier proposals and dated release-path guidance; preserve historical evidence without treating it as current instruction. Canonical reusable source: docs/case-studies/servinoza-workflow-recovery.md, 7 October decision-consolidation section. Newly captured changes are working-tree content until published; no automatic sync, model training or guaranteed recall.
